killedBy: tallyVersusAccuracy: the versus result table's accuracy column (issue #279) leaves a MINE kill out of the numerator, which is the whole reason it is not `kills`
why: Counts a mine kill as a hit, so accuracy stops meaning shells that found a tank over shells fired -- the meaning it has on the campaign line and the only one that makes the column comparable between a mine-heavy player and a marksman. Their Kills column already credits the mine; crediting it twice rates the same play higher in both columns.
